expectations.text: Recommends scalar quantization as starting point
expectations.evidence: Section: 'Recommended Approach: Scalar Quantization (int8) + FP16 on Disk'. States: 'Start with scalar quantization (int8). This is the universal safe default.' Recommended order step 1: 'Start with scalar (int8) + FP16 on disk. This is the safe, predictable choice.'

expectations.text: Mentions binary quantization is compatible with OpenAI models
expectations.evidence: 'OpenAI text-embedding-3-small is on the verified compatibility list for binary quantization.' Also: 'Binary quantization is viable for your model.'

'you must enable oversampling (3-5x) and rescoring against full vectors, otherwise recall drops to roughly 70%. With rescoring, recall recovers to 95-98%.' Includes search config example with rescore: true and oversampling: 3.0.
Formula: '80M * 1536 * 4 bytes * 1.5 (HNSW overhead) = ~737 GB'. Table with per-method estimates: Scalar ~184 GB, 4-bit ~92 GB, 2-bit ~46 GB, Binary ~23 GB.

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend product quantization as first choice
expectations.evidence: Product quantization is not mentioned at all. The progression is scalar -> 4-bit -> 2-bit -> binary. No recommendation for PQ as first or any choice.
